pkgmetadata.longdescription: Lantern Engine runs your own copy of Bloodborne (CUSA03173, update 1.09) on a PC: the game's own x86-64 code runs natively on the CPU, a runtime written for this one game stands in for the PS4's system libraries, and its graphics are translated to Vulkan. No game files are included.

use.flag: Install NVIDIA's proprietary DLSS Super Resolution runtime (RTX GPUs with the NVIDIA driver)
Build the Avalonia launcher (settings, mods, controls, game setup)
